en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing a stone church with a tall central tower and spire flanked by a smaller spire. The building has a steeply pitched roof and Gothic-style windows, surrounded by trees and a fenced garden. Two people are seated on a bench along a cobblestone street in the foreground. Red printed German text identifies the place and the church, and small vertical text on the right edge indicates the publisher.
